mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserLock */ USER_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getActiveTimerDtl */ TIMER.TMRX_NUMB , TIMER.USER_NUMB , TIMER.REPT_NUMB , TIMER.TMRX_STAT , TIMER.TARG_SECS , TIMER.READ_SECS , TIMER.ALRM_DATE , TIMER.SEND_DATE , TIMER.STRT_DATE , TIMER.LAST_STRT , TIMER.ENDX_DATE , TIMER.REGI_DATE , TIMER.UPDT_DATE , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = TIMER.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = REPORT.BOOK_NUMB WHERE TIMER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND TIMER.TMRX_STAT IN (#{runningStat}, #{pausedStat}) ORDER BY TIMER.TMRX_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* getTimerDtl */ TMRX_NUMB , USER_NUMB , REPT_NUMB , TMRX_STAT , TARG_SECS , READ_SECS , ALRM_DATE , SEND_DATE , STRT_DATE , LAST_STRT , ENDX_DATE , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE FROM TM_RDTMRX WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND TMRX_NUMB = #{tmrxNumb}

SELECT /* getBookTimeList */ CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(REPORT.REPT_NUMB ORDER BY TIMER.ENDX_DATE DESC, TIMER.TMRX_NUMB DESC) , ',' , 1 ) AS UNSIGNED) AS REPT_NUMB , REPORT.BOOK_NUMB , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM , SUM(GREATEST(TIMER.READ_SECS, 0)) AS READ_SECS , MAX(TIMER.ENDX_DATE) AS LAST_READ_DATE FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = TIMER.REPT_NUMB AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = TIMER.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = REPORT.BOOK_NUMB WHERE TIMER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND TIMER.TMRX_STAT = #{completedStat} AND TIMER.READ_SECS > 0 GROUP BY REPORT.BOOK_NUMB , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM ORDER BY LAST_READ_DATE DESC , REPORT.BOOK_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}

SELECT /* getDueTimerAlimList */ TIMER.TMRX_NUMB FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = TIMER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{activeUserStat} WHERE TIMER.TMRX_STAT IN (#{runningStat}, #{completedStat}) AND TIMER.TARG_SECS IS NOT NULL AND TIMER.ALRM_DATE <= #{alarmDate} AND TIMER.SEND_DATE IS NULL ORDER BY TIMER.ALRM_DATE , TIMER.TMRX_NUMB LIMIT #{maxSize}

SELECT /* getDueTimerAlimDtl */ TIMER.TMRX_NUMB , TIMER.USER_NUMB , TIMER.TMRX_STAT , TIMER.TARG_SECS , TIMER.READ_SECS , TIMER.ALRM_DATE , TIMER.SEND_DATE , TIMER.LAST_STRT FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = TIMER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{activeUserStat} WHERE TIMER.TMRX_NUMB = #{tmrxNumb} AND TIMER.TMRX_STAT = #{runningStat} AND TIMER.TARG_SECS IS NOT NULL AND TIMER.ALRM_DATE <= #{alarmDate} AND TIMER.SEND_DATE IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getTimerAlimDtl */ TIMER.TMRX_NUMB , TIMER.USER_NUMB , TIMER.TMRX_STAT , TIMER.TARG_SECS , TIMER.ALRM_DATE , TIMER.SEND_DATE FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = TIMER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{activeUserStat} WHERE TIMER.TMRX_NUMB = #{tmrxNumb} AND TIMER.TMRX_STAT = #{completedStat} AND TIMER.TARG_SECS IS NOT NULL AND TIMER.ALRM_DATE <= #{alarmDate} AND TIMER.SEND_DATE IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptTimerAlimCancel */ TM_RDTMRX SET ALRM_DATE = NULL , UPDT_DATE = #{updtDate} WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND ALRM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SEND_DATE IS NULL
mapper.insert: /* setReadingDaily */ INSERT INTO TB_RDATDX (USER_NUMB, READ_DATE, READ_SECS, UPDT_DATE) VALUES (#{userNumb}, #{readDate}, #{readSecs}, #{updtDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_SECS = READ_SECS + VALUES(READ_SECS), UPDT_DATE = VALUES(UPDT_DATE)
